label: Nathan Tompkins and colleagues, Testing…: Tompkins and colleagues report that diffusively coupled…
interpretation: Scoped primary experimental report from a pinned publisher-formatted PDF on a third-party mirror. Chemical cells are artificial abiotic droplets, not reproducing organisms. Experimenters prepare apparatus and boundary conditions; therefore this is evidence for pattern emergence by reaction/diffusion, not a demonstration that no intelligent being has any causal role. The abstract/body discrepancy on a pattern count is not used. No claim that all nonliving regularity, physical laws themselves or biological development is thereby explained.
